instruction: 最快的刹车可以通过快速改变腿前后位置和车身倾角，在不倒的条件下快速停车；不要把腿目标突然变化本身当作缺陷。
authorized_objective: rapid coordinated leg/body/wheel braking, stable arrest and return, forward/reverse and yaw
interpretation: Judge direction, phase, deceleration, stopping distance and balance. Action smoothness alone is not an optimization objective.
ongoing_diagnostic: The frozen all/leg/wheel relaxation replay remains a causal isolation experiment only. It cannot by itself justify adopting blanket smoothing or relaxing response targets.
